svg.title: Recipe domain: card family, Browse toolbar and RecipeDetailSheet (Era 3)
svg.desc: Layer 3B shipped Recipe domain board for WFS Family Cookbook Era 3.
svg.text: WFS / Shared Table · Family Cookbook Era 3
Shipped recipe visual language across Home, Browse stack/grid, Discovery voting, and RecipeDetailSheet.
Part 1 · Shipped Recipe Card Family across 4 contexts
Card header holds blush Ready in pill (white surface)
QuickFindModal adds inline View details ▾ above Skip / Select
Photo holds solid bg-cream Ready in; tap opens RecipeDetailSheet
Warm tortillas, spiced beef and colourful peppers ready for
everyone to assemble at the table (line-clamp-2 if non-empty).
Swipe overlays: LOVE (garden-fill) / PASS (hearth-fill); clean body
Part 2 · Recipes Browse toolbar & planning banner
Search input + Filters + Clear expand below trigger
409 search cursors auto-restart once before Hearth Retry
Primary when confirmed planned; neutral white otherwise
View Original sits at hero bottom-right on bg-cream/90 translucent capsule (never obscures title; keyboard-focusable outline-ink-body).
Original quantities & Reset view live under ••• menu.
Slice onions & peppers; brown beef over medium.
Simmer with seasoning and assemble tortillas.
Scaled notice appears quietly when factor != 1 without hiding steps.
Household Order: 1 Rating → 2 Notes (directly writable) → 3 Ask the Family
Directly writable field (no wrapping card/duplicate title);
unconfirmed edits keep draft + inline Hearth Retry save.
Shows in Discovery voting (DiscoveryToggleCard · 56x32 garden-fill switch)
Edit Conflict & Pre-Commit Planning Recovery (Hearth inline cards)
Save conflicts open directly with Keep my draft / Use currently saved pills · Occupied & non-cooking slots confirm before commit.
Phone (< 768px): full-screen sheet; Tablet (>= 768px): max-w-5xl rounded dialog.
Bottom Planning Dock (scrollable max-h-[45dvh], safe-area bottom padding)
